headline: JFE Steel selected for the Nippon Foundation–DeepStar CO2 transport pipeline R&D project
summary: JFE Steel has been selected to join the Nippon Foundation–DeepStar joint R&D programme on CO2 transport pipelines, testing its ERW "Mighty Seam" line pipe (material testing at its Chiba Steel Research Laboratory) to establish how impurities in captured CO2 affect steel strength and fracture resistance and to develop material requirements for CO2 pipelines underpinning CCS/CCUS.
co2crc_note: CO2-stream impurity tolerance and pipeline metallurgy are a shared technical bottleneck for Australia's offshore CO2-transport ambitions.

headline: Texas appellate court sends Occidental carbon-capture dispute to arbitration
summary: A Texas appellate court revived Occidental Petroleum's bid to arbitrate a multi-million-dollar dispute arising from a project to deploy carbon-capture technology in Australia, ruling that a British Columbia tribunal is the appropriate venue and sending the claims to arbitration.
co2crc_note: Illustrates contractual/commercial-dispute risk in cross-border CCS technology deployment, with a direct Australian nexus.
